references.text: Ehud repeats that he has a secret message for the king, continuing the theme of secrecy from verse 19.
Jael asks Sisera to stay hidden and keep silent, similar to how Eglon ordered silence.
Gilgal is mentioned as an important place in Israel's history, where the Israelites set up stones after crossing the Jordan.
Samuel speaks of a secret word for Saul, similar to Ehud's secret message to Eglon.
David sends away his servants before receiving private information, similar to how Eglon sent away his servants.
